alerts.name: SLO: API Error Rate > 1%
alerts.query: select count() from events where project.slug = 'sophia-ai-factory' and event.type = 'error' and transaction.name starts with '/api/'
alerts.condition: count() > 0.01 * (select count() from events where project.slug = 'sophia-ai-factory' and transaction.name starts with '/api/')

payload.text:
🚨 SLO BREACH: API Error Rate > 1%
Burn rate critical - investigate immediately

alerts.name: SLO: API Latency p95 > 800ms
alerts.query: select percentile(duration, 95) as p95 from transactions where project.slug = 'sophia-ai-factory' and transaction.name starts with '/api/'

alerts.name: SLO: Health Latency p95 > 500ms
alerts.query: select percentile(duration, 95) as p95 from transactions where project.slug = 'sophia-ai-factory' and transaction.name in ('/api/health', '/api/version')

alerts.name: SLO: Availability < 99.5%
alerts.query: select count() as total, countif(status >= 200 and status < 400) as good from transactions where project.slug = 'sophia-ai-factory'

payload.text:
🚨 SLO BREACH: Availability < 99.5%
Critical availability degradation - incident bridge required

alerts.name: SLO: Webhook Delivery p95 > 5min
alerts.query: select percentile(duration, 95) as p95 from transactions where project.slug = 'sophia-ai-factory' and transaction.name starts with '/webhook/'
